'''K'ath''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[K'ath system/Legends|K'ath system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. An [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]], K'ath was most notable for its [[seashell]]s, which local artisans would craft into figurines. In addition to these trinkets, visitors knew K'ath for its wide beaches and terraced hills.
